public_rationale: Zitron points to three statements: Murati's denial, OpenAI's line that AI voices should not deliberately mimic a celebrity's voice (e1), and the 'in conversation' framing about Johansson's team (e2). Calling them lies would require evidence that they were false and that OpenAI knew it. The evidence in this case does not show that. The Washington Post reported on May 22, 2024 that the Sky actor was hired months before Altman contacted Johansson, according to documents, recordings, casting directors and the actor's agent (e3). That cuts against the central alleged lie, the denial that Sky imitated Johansson. But some of the documents came from OpenAI (e3). NPR reported on May 31, 2024 that it was still unknown whether Altman privately told the casting team to use Johansson as an inspiration (e4). The OpenAI page as retrieved, updated May 22, lists Altman's September 2023 and May 10, 2024 outreach to Johansson next to the 'in conversation' line (e2). The case does not show how the page was worded before the post. Whether the framing was a lie by omission is a matter of judgment. The evidence leans against the claim but does not settle it.
limitations: Intent and knowledge cannot be observed directly. The case has little evidence on either.
The Washington Post relied partly on documents OpenAI chose to share.
The case contains no court filings, discovery or internal records that test OpenAI's denials.
The retrieved OpenAI page is a later updated version. It does not show the wording at the time of Zitron's post.

statement.excerpt: Just so we are abundantly, painfully, earnestly clear here, OpenAI lied to the media multiple times.
statement.document_title: Sam Altman Is Full Of Shit

from_speaker: Murati said Sky wasn't meant to sound like Johansson
"AI voices should not deliberately mimic a celebrity's distinct voice"
"in conversations" with Johansson's representatives, by omission
our_interpretation: Read in context, the claim is that OpenAI's statements to the press about Sky in May 2024 were knowingly false or deliberately misleading on more than one occasion. The core alleged falsehood is the denial that Sky was meant to imitate Johansson.

A lie means a statement the company knew was false, or an omission meant to mislead. Showing that Sky resembles Johansson is not enough by itself. There has to be evidence that the denials were untrue.
The period covers Sky's casting and design, from early 2023, through OpenAI's statements up to the post date.
criteria.support_condition: Public documents, testimony, court records or credible reporting showing that OpenAI meant Sky to imitate Johansson, or that its May 2024 press statements about Sky's origin or withdrawal were false and OpenAI knew it.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible records showing Sky was cast and designed without reference to Johansson, so that OpenAI's denials were accurate, and no evidence that other statements were false.
